subject: physics-hl
prompt: A ball is thrown vertically upwards with a speed of $12\ \text{m s}^{-1}$. Air resistance is negligible. What is the maximum height reached by the ball?
explanation: At the top $v = 0$, so $v^2 = u^2 - 2gh$ gives $h = \dfrac{u^2}{2g} = \dfrac{12^2}{2 \times 9.81} \approx 7.3\ \text{m}$.

prompt: A motor lifts a $50\ \text{kg}$ mass vertically through $3.0\ \text{m}$ at constant speed in $6.0\ \text{s}$. What is the useful power output of the motor? ($g = 9.8\ \text{m s}^{-2}$)
explanation: $P = \dfrac{mgh}{t} = \dfrac{50 \times 9.8 \times 3.0}{6.0} = 245\ \text{W}$. $1470\ \text{W}$ is the work done, not the power.

prompt: Light above the threshold frequency shines on a metal surface. The intensity of the light is increased while the frequency stays the same. What increases?
options: The maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons
The threshold frequency of the metal
The number of photoelectrons emitted per second
The work function of the metal
explanation: Higher intensity means more photons per second, so more photoelectrons per second. Each photon still has energy $hf$, so the maximum kinetic energy $hf - \Phi$ is unchanged.
